Return a dummy session JSON if LOGGED_IN is True if self.LOGGED_IN: return {"session": "dummy_session"} return None def test_normal_extraction_with_webpage_data(tmp_path): """Test extraction when reference_id is not in URL and data is parsed from webpage.""" url = "https://www.safaribooksonline.com/library/view/hadoop-fundamentals-livelessons/9780133392838/part00.html" ie = DummySafariIE() result = ie._real_extract(url) # The result should be a Kaltura URL with correct query parameters assert result._type == "url" assert result._url.startswith("https://cdnapisec.kaltura.com/html5/html5lib/v2.37.1/mwEmbedFrame.php") parsed = re.search(r"wid=_(?P[^&]+)&uiconf_id=(?P[^&]+)&flashvars%5BreferenceId%5D=(?P[^&]+)", result._url) assert parsed, "Expected query parameters not found" assert parsed.group("wid") == "partner-9780133392838-part00" assert parsed.group("uiconf") == "ui-9780133392838-part00" assert parsed.group("ref") == "ref-9780133392838-part00" def test_extraction_with_reference_id_in_url(tmp_path): """Test extraction when reference_id is present directly in the URL.""" url = "https://www.safaribooksonline.com/videos/python-programming-language/9780134217314/9780134217314-PYMC_13_00" ie = DummySafariIE() result = ie._real_extract(url) # The result should contain the reference_id from the URL assert result._type == "url" assert result._url.startswith("https://cdnapisec.kaltura.com/html5/html5lib/v2.37.1/mwEmbedFrame.php") parsed = re.search(r"flashvars%5BreferenceId%5D=(?P[^&]+)", result._url) assert parsed, "Reference ID not found in query" assert parsed.group("ref") == "9780134217314-PYMC_13_00" def test_extraction_without_kaltura_session(tmp_path): """Test extraction when LOGGED_IN is True but no session JSON is returned.""" url = "https://www.safaribooksonline.com/library/view/hadoop-fundamentals-livelessons/9780133392838/part00.html" ie = DummySafariIE(logged_in=True) # Override _download_json to return None to simulate missing session def no_session(url, video_id, note, errnote, fatal, headers): return None ie._download_json = no_session result = ie._real_extract(url) # Ensure that the URL does not contain a flashvars[ks] parameter assert "flashvars%5Bks%5D=" not in result._url ```
